report.title_account.description: The title of the panel that reports an account to the moderators. {handle} is the account's handle (@name@server).

report.title_room.description: The title of the panel that reports a voice chat room to the moderators. {name} is the room's name as its host wrote it.

report.title_event.description: The title of the panel that reports an event to the moderators. {name} is the event's title as its organizer wrote it.

report.close.description: The name of the button that closes the report panel without sending it.

report.cancel.description: The button of the report panel that closes it without sending the report.

report.intro.defaultMessage: {kind, select, room {The moderators of {instance} read your report. It is not public, and the room's host, {handle}, is never told who sent it.} event {The moderators of {instance} read your report. It is not public, and the event's organizer, {handle}, is never told who sent it.} other {The moderators of {instance} read your report. It is not public, and {handle} is never told who sent it.}}
report.intro.description: The first sentences of the report panel: who reads the report, and that the reported account never learns who sent it. {kind} is room (a voice chat room, reported with its host), event (an event, reported with its organizer) or account. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name. {handle} is the account's handle.

report.intro.unavailable.defaultMessage: The moderators of {instance} read your report. It is not public, and the event's organizer is never told who sent it.
report.intro.unavailable.description: The first sentences of the panel that reports an event whose organizer the reader may not see (suspended, deactivated, hidden by the moderators, or blocking the reader): who reads the report, and that the organizer never learns who sent it; report.intro otherwise. {instance} is the server's display name, or its domain name.

report.category.description: The heading of the choice of why the reader reports the account, the room or the event.

report.category_name.defaultMessage: {category, select, spam {Spam} legal {Illegal content} violation {Breaks the server's rules} other {Something else}}
report.category_name.description: The name of a reason for a report, one choice of the report panel. {category} is spam, legal (content that breaks the law), violation (breaks the server's rules, which the reader then chooses) or other.

report.spam_hint.defaultMessage: Unwanted ads, the same post over and over, or misleading links
report.spam_hint.description: What the reason Spam covers, under its name in the report panel; the other reasons have none.

report.category_missing.defaultMessage: Choose why you are reporting this.
report.category_missing.description: The error under the reasons of the report panel, when the reader sends it without choosing one.

report.rules.description: The heading of the choice of the server's rules that the reported account breaks, shown once the reader chose that reason.

report.rules_missing.defaultMessage: Choose at least one rule this breaks.
report.rules_missing.description: The error under the server's rules in the report panel, when the reader sends it without choosing any.

report.posts.description: The heading of the choice of the account's posts that the report points the moderators at.

report.posts_hint.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Choose up to {max} posts. None chosen yet.} one {Choose up to {max} posts. # chosen.} other {Choose up to {max} posts. # chosen.}}
report.posts_hint.description: Under the heading of the posts to include in a report: how many may be chosen ({max}, 20) and how many are ({count}).

report.posts_loading.description: Said in the place of the account's posts in the report panel while they load.

report.posts_none.defaultMessage: There are no posts to include. You can still send the report.
report.posts_none.description: Said in the place of the account's posts in the report panel when the reader sees none of them.

report.posts_failed.defaultMessage: The posts could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.
report.posts_failed.description: Said in the place of the account's posts in the report panel when they could not be read; Try again follows it.

report.retry.description: The button that reads the account's posts again in the report panel.

report.post_warning.description: A post behind a content warning, among the posts to include in a report: its warning in place of its text. {warning} is the warning its author wrote.

report.post_no_text.description: A post that has no text (its images alone), among the posts to include in a report.

report.comment.description: The label of the field of the report panel where the reader writes to the moderators.

report.comment_hint.description: The hint under the comment of a report. {max} is 1000.

report.comment_rule.defaultMessage: Shorten the comment to {max, number} characters or fewer.
report.comment_rule.description: The error under the comment of a report when it is too long. {max} is 1000.

report.forward.defaultMessage: Also send the report to the moderators of {domain}
report.forward.description: The checkbox of the report panel, for an account of another server: send the report to that server's moderators too. {domain} is that server's domain name.

report.forward_hint.defaultMessage: Your name is not sent with it.
report.forward_hint.description: Under the checkbox that sends a report to another server's moderators: the report goes without naming the reader.

report.send.description: The button that sends the report to the moderators.

report.sent_title.description: The title of the report panel once the report was sent.

report.also.defaultMessage: What else you can do about {handle}
report.also.description: The heading over muting and blocking the reported account, once the report was sent. {handle} is the account's handle.

report.mute.description: The name for assistive technology of the button Mute once the report was sent: it mutes the reported account. {handle} is the account's handle.

report.mute_short.description: The button that mutes the reported account once the report was sent; the heading over it names the account.

report.block.description: The name for assistive technology of the button Block… once the report was sent: it blocks the reported account, after a confirmation. {handle} is the account's handle.

report.block_short.description: The button that blocks the reported account once the report was sent, after a confirmation; the heading over it names the account.

report.muted.description: Said in the place of the mute button once the reported account was muted.

report.blocked.description: Said in the place of the block button once the reported account was blocked.

report.mute_failed.defaultMessage: {handle} could not be muted. Check your connection, then try again.
report.mute_failed.description: Said over the mute button when muting the reported account failed.

report.block_failed.defaultMessage: {handle} could not be blocked. Check your connection, then try again.
report.block_failed.description: Said over the block button when blocking the reported account failed.

report.done.description: The button that closes the report panel once the report was sent.
